chip.line.both.toEnemyPool: Enemy fallen + your survivors → enemy morale
chip.line.both.toPlayerPool: Your fallen + enemy survivors → your morale
chip.risk.casualties: The most morale you can lose this turn: every unit in your hand falling. Only your own fallen cost you — win without losses and you lose nothing.
chip.risk.survivors: The most morale you can lose this turn: every enemy in the wave surviving the fight. Kill them and you lose nothing.
chip.power.casualties.player: what your morale loses if this unit falls
chip.power.casualties.enemy: what the enemy morale loses when this unit falls
chip.power.casualties.side: what its side's morale loses if this unit falls
chip.power.survivors: chips the opposing morale each turn it survives

save.rejected: This run was saved by an older version of the game and can't be continued. Your settings and unlocks are kept.
save.elsewhere: The game is open in another tab. This tab can't continue your run, and a run started here won't be saved.
save.unavailable: The game can't save here: its storage is blocked or full. A run won't survive closing the tab.
failure.boot.title: ASCIIbattler couldn't start
failure.webgl.body: This browser couldn't start WebGL 2, which the game draws with. Turning on hardware acceleration in the browser's settings may fix it; otherwise try another browser.
failure.boot.body: Something the game needs didn't load. Reloading the page may fix it.
failure.run.title: The game hit an error
failure.run.body: The game has stopped. Reload the page to go on: Continue picks a saved run up at its last choice.
failure.context.title: The picture was lost
failure.context.body: The browser took the game's drawing surface away and hasn't given it back, so the game has stopped. Reload the page to go on: Continue picks a saved run up at its last choice.

settings.title: Settings
settings.chipTooltip: Settings: volume, speed and comfort. Quit to menu is here too.
settings.speed.hint: Battles start at this speed each time you open the game.
settings.aura.hint: How an aura shows its reach: waves from its carrier, or motes over the area.
settings.textScale.hint: Takes effect when you close settings. Larger sizes need a larger window.
settings.motion.hint: Reduced stops the shake, the flying orbs and the scenery's drift. System follows your device.
settings.shake.hint: Whose morale losses shake the view.
settings.palette.hint: Colorblind sets your units, the enemy's, a camp's and the stone further apart, for red-green and blue-yellow color vision.
settings.palette.current: The game is drawn in this palette.
settings.palette.waits: The new palette is drawn once the game reloads.
settings.palette.waits.saved: The new palette is drawn once the game reloads. Your run is saved, and Continue returns to it. A fight in progress starts again from its turn.
settings.palette.waits.unsaved: The new palette is drawn once the game reloads. This run can't be saved here, so a reload ends it.
settings.key.hint: Click a key, then press the new one. A key already in use swaps places with it. Esc cancels.
settings.key.swapped: {name} is on {key} now, and {other} moved to {otherKey}.
settings.key.resetDone: Every key is back to its default.
settings.data.backup.hint: Your settings, unlocks, saved run and finished runs as one file, to keep or to carry to another browser.
settings.data.backup.none: Nothing can be read from the game's storage here, so there is nothing to export.
settings.data.import.hint: Puts a backup file in place of everything saved here.
settings.data.chosen.ready: A backup from {when}, made by version {build}. Importing replaces everything saved here, a run in progress included, then reloads the game.
settings.data.chosen.notBackup: That file isn't a backup of this game. Nothing was changed.
settings.data.chosen.otherVersion: That backup is from another version of the game, and this one can't read it. Nothing was changed.
settings.data.chosen.failed: The backup couldn't be stored here. What was saved before is still in place.
settings.data.chosen.mixed: The backup couldn't be stored here, and not all of what was saved before could be put back.
settings.data.chosen.elsewhere: The game is open in another tab, which holds the saved run. Close that tab and reload this one to import.
settings.data.chosen.unavailable: The game can't save here, so a backup can't be imported.
settings.data.lastRun.hint: The journal of the last run that ended: its seed and every choice you made, enough to replay it. Send it along with a bug report or feedback.
settings.data.lastRun.none: No run has ended here yet.
settings.quit.saved: Your run is saved, and Continue returns to it. A fight in progress starts again from its turn.
settings.quit.unsaved: This run can't be saved here, so quitting ends it.
